tests: doctor promotes a not-applicable retention to FAIL under --for full and leaves it a WARN under every profile below, in a fleet that tiphys init just created

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Rule (f) is derived per FILE: every member below mutates src/commands/doctor.ts, which spawns `git check-ignore -q` to reach its other retention verdicts, so the capture obligation binds even though the arms these tests guard return BEFORE that spawn. The citation is load-bearing rather than ceremonial: the tests assert that none of the three verdicts downstream of the git-consulting loop (git-ignored, does not exist, present and tracked) appears in the not-applicable line, and the capture is where those verdicts' external contract is recorded (ignored 0, unignored 1, outside a repository 128, git 2.43.0, 2026-08-13). THREE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT MEMBERS, one per way the promotion can be undone. Member 0 takes the condition out of the `full` list, which is the exact state M4-P30 reversed and the guard that could not go red. Member 1 leaves it in the table and attaches it to `generic` as well, so the promotion is over-applied rather than removed and the arm that keeps a fresh `tiphys init` fleet usable below full reddens instead. Member 2 touches no profile at all: it turns the not-applicable verdict into a silent PASS, and since only a WARN is ever promoted the promotion machinery then never fires, which is the SC-011 shape the split must not reintroduce.
